queries: WITH c AS (SELECT m.college AS college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income FROM income i JOIN member mb ON mb.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major m ON m.major_id = mb.link_to_major WHERE m.college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.college) SELECT college, total_income, CAST(total_income AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(total_income) FROM c) AS fraction_of_total FROM c;

WITH linked AS (SELECT m.college AS college, i.amount AS amount FROM income i JOIN member mb ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id WHERE m.college IS NOT NULL) SELECT college, SUM(amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM linked) AS fraction_of_total FROM linked GROUP BY college

WITH linked AS (SELECT m.college AS college, i.amount AS amount FROM income i JOIN member mem ON mem.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major m ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major) SELECT college, SUM(amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM linked) AS fraction_of_total FROM linked GROUP BY college

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT m.college AS college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income FROM income i JOIN member mb ON mb.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major m ON m.major_id = mb.link_to_major WHERE m.college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.college) SELECT college, total_income, CAST(total_income AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(total_income) FROM c) AS fraction_of_total FROM c;

assumptions.assumption: Inner joins from income to member (via link_to_member) to major (via link_to_major) drop unlinked income; majors with NULL college are excluded from the denominator and output.
The fraction is returned as an unrounded decimal (total divided by the sum across all matched colleges), cast to REAL to avoid integer division.

responses.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT m.college AS college, i.amount AS amount FROM income i JOIN member mb ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id WHERE m.college IS NOT NULL) SELECT college, SUM(amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM linked) AS fraction_of_total FROM linked GROUP BY college

assumptions.assumption: Income is linked via income.link_to_member to member, then member.link_to_major to major, using inner joins so unlinked income is dropped. Income whose major has a NULL college is excluded, since only income matched to a college counts toward the total.
The fraction is a ratio between 0 and 1, not a percentage. It is computed in floating point with no rounding.

responses.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT m.college AS college, i.amount AS amount FROM income i JOIN member mem ON mem.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major m ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major) SELECT college, SUM(amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM linked) AS fraction_of_total FROM linked GROUP BY college

assumptions.assumption: Inner joins from income to member to major drop income with no linked member or major; the fraction's denominator is the total of only these matched incomes. Division is done as REAL to avoid integer division, with no rounding.
Colleges are grouped by the college name text. A NULL college, if present, forms its own group and counts toward the denominator.
